high_level_description: The image depicts a fashion runway scene. The central focus is on a model walking down the runway. She is wearing a dark, oversized shirt with short sleeves and a high collar. The shirt has a structured design with visible buttons running down the front. Over the shirt, she wears a long, flowing skirt made of what appears to be feathers or a similar material, in shades of brown, purple, and white. The skirt is layered and has a textured, almost fringed appearance. The model has a short, styled haircut and is wearing large, dangling earrings. Her expression is serious and focused as she walks.
